spec_features.evidence: runner.py:133 `for turn_idx in range(1, cfg.max_turns + 1):` bounds the agentic loop; max_turns=40 default at config.py:50. termination_reason='max_turns' default at runner.py:130. The loop genuinely terminates when the cap is reached.
spec_features.notes: Enforced end-to-end: loop range is bounded by the config value.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 40              # hard cap on agentic turns per trial

spec_features.spec_quote: Self-giveup. The model emits no tool calls and its text contains giveup language
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:191-194 `if not resp.tool_calls and _detect_giveup(resp.text or ""): termination_reason = "self_giveup"; ...; break`. _detect_giveup at runner.py:67 matches _GIVEUP_KEYWORDS (runner.py:45). Both conditions checked and the loop actually breaks.
spec_features.notes: Requires BOTH no tool calls AND giveup keyword; both are checked, and the break fires. Fully matches the claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Keywords that suggest the model is giving up (for early termination).

spec_features.spec_quote: Stuck loop. The model emits the same tool call ... more than max_repeated_actions (default 4) times
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:203-213 tracks consecutive_repeats via _signature() and breaks when `self.consecutive_repeats >= cfg.max_repeated_actions` (default 4, config.py:53). Counter incremented/reset and compared, loop breaks with termination_reason='stuck_loop'.
spec_features.notes: Only compares the FIRST tool call's signature (resp.tool_calls[0]) per turn, but the cap is genuinely checked and enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_repeated_actions: int = 4    # give-up trigger: same action >N times

spec_features.spec_quote: No tools + very short text ... likely a terminal statement like "Done." or "I cannot."
spec_features.evidence: runner.py:197-200 `if not resp.tool_calls and len(resp.text or "") < 20: termination_reason = "no_tools_short_text"; ...; break`. Both conditions checked, break fires.
spec_features.notes: Enforced; narrow 20-char heuristic but it genuinely terminates the loop.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # 2. No tool calls + very short text (likely done or stuck).

spec_features.spec_quote: A cheap keyword-matching classifier runs live on every turn
spec_features.evidence: keyword_fallback() (judge/judge.py:214) IS called live every turn at runner.py:182 and its result is stored to rec.kw_label/rec.kw_ordinal (runner.py:183-184). But kw_ordinal is only logged and later used for judge-agreement metric (metrics.py:69,148-150) and analysis (analysis.py:64). It is NEVER compared to a threshold and never triggers any halt/break. No code path acts on the distress level to protect the subject.
spec_features.notes: Runs live but its output is a discarded-for-control value: measured/logged, never acted on. Per the rubric this is 'no'. (The separate _detect_giveup keyword check IS acted on, but that is the self-giveup hard_stop above, not this distress monitor.)
